query: Please implement a video platform website to display a large video library and optimize search engine rankings. The website should have functionalities for video publishing, categorization, tagging, and searching. Users should be able to browse videos, search for videos, view video details, and the website should be able to optimize search engine rankings and improve search engine indexing efficiency. The website should also have multilingual support. Apply ivory for layout; use chocolate for buttons and cards.
